title: 第7章 七擒七方无支祈臣服你可知站在你面前这位是何人第8章 神通祸水滔天与先天灵宝不积跬步无以至千里
slug: 洪荒截教大师兄收徒就能变强
lines: 白浪化啸滚滚，托起凶神恶煞的白头青身巨妖。
然而，听到这番话的青渊却是一愣，错愕道：“你要拜入……圣人门下？”
不来拜师圣人，我千里迢迢吃了那么多苦头跑来这里做什么？不就是为了拜入圣人门下吗？”
无支祁冷哼道：“洪荒谁不知道上清通天教主立教号称愿为洪荒众生开辟一线生机，有教无类广收门人！
我花了这么多年来昆仑山，就是为了拜入圣人门下！”
“你问这么多作甚？不敢答应便滚！
恐怕无支祁有心拜师，却无缘截教。
老师通天教主虽然没有像元始天尊一样设下重重先天禁制、杀阵筛选徒弟，但……
有时候再翻越多一座山恐怕便能到达截教，甚至前面拐个弯就能到，难无缘者缘法不够隔着纱窗都进不去。
青渊不去想那么多，点头道：“我答应你的条件。”
无支祁大喜，也放下狠话：“若你真能在水中赢吾，你就算让吾去死，吾都不皱眉头！”
无支祈便站在水面上，傲视二人。
无支祁有些烦躁，叫道：“要么快些来擒我，要么带我去找截教，浪费什么时间？”
仅仅是大手一挥，滔天巨浪化作凶戾无边的剑势卷向无支祁。
但他还没能反应过来，赖以为生的江水竟化作一柄柄锋锐骇人的剑气裹着他，一旦他胆敢动弹将会魂飞魄散！
content_en:
On Yuejiang Bay.
The white waves roared and rolled, lifting up the ferocious white-headed and blue-bodied giant monster.
The giant monster is also arrogant.
Speak out your inner thoughts.
However, Qing Yuan was stunned when he heard these words and said in astonishment: "You want to become a disciple of... a saint?"
"Nonsense!
If I don’t come to learn from the saint, why would I come here after all the hardships I’ve endured? Isn’t it just to become a saint? "
Wuzhi Qi snorted coldly: "Who in the prehistoric times doesn't know that the leader of the Shangqing Tongtian Cult established the religion and claimed that he would open up a chance of life for all sentient beings in the prehistoric times, and that he would recruit disciples regardless of category?
I have spent so many years in Kunlun Mountain just to become a disciple of the saint! "
"It's a pity..."
"Why are you asking so many questions? If you don't agree, then get out!
! "
See this.
Qingyuan pondered inwardly.
I'm afraid that Wuzhiqi wanted to become a disciple, but he didn't have the chance to teach him.
Although the teacher, Master Tongtian, did not set up numerous innate restrictions and killing formations to screen his disciples like Yuanshi Tianzun, but...
Those who have no chance,
Difficult to teach.
Sometimes, if you climb one more mountain, you might be able to reach Jiejiao, or you can even reach it just by turning a corner in front of you. But those who are not destined to have good luck cannot even get in through the screen window.
Qingyuan didn't think too much, nodded and said: "I agree to your conditions."
"Okay, then come and capture me!"
Wuzhi Qi was overjoyed and put down his cruel words: "If you can really beat me in the water, even if you let me die, I won't even frown!"
The words fell.
Wuzhiqi stood on the water and looked down upon the two of them.
"Why not avoid it?"
Qingyuan frowned.
"Because I'm not afraid!"
"Why aren't you afraid?"
"If you're not afraid, you're not afraid!"
Wuzhiqi was a little irritated and shouted: "Either come and capture me quickly, or take me to find Jie Jiao, what time is wasting?"
"Okay."
Qingyuan nodded.
With just a wave of his hand, the huge wave turned into a ferocious and boundless sword force and rolled towards Wuzhi Qi.
Wuzhiqi felt terrified inside.
But before he could react, the river water he relied on turned into sharp and terrifying sword energy and enveloped him. If he dared to move, his soul would be shattered!
